title: L'hiver arrive!
oneGoal: Students understand that 'hiver' means winter and can identify winter weather signs
decisionPoints: Are students familiar with seasonal vocabulary?
Do students need visual winter weather supports?
Should I include local winter experiences?
progression: Foundation lesson - introduces winter season and basic vocabulary
realWorldConnection: Winter brings changes in weather, clothing, and activities that affect daily life

title: Que porte-t-on en hiver?
oneGoal: Students can name 3 winter clothing items in French
decisionPoints: Are students ready for clothing vocabulary?
Do students need to touch real winter clothes?
Should I include different cultural winter clothing?
progression: Builds on Lesson 1 by adding what we wear when it's froid and neige
realWorldConnection: People wear special clothes to stay warm during winter

title: Activités d'hiver amusantes
oneGoal: Students can identify winter activities they can do outside
decisionPoints: Do students have experience with winter activities?
Should I focus on activities available locally?
Are students ready for action vocabulary?
progression: Builds on Lesson 2 by exploring what we DO in hiver when wearing warm clothes
realWorldConnection: Winter offers unique outdoor activities and fun experiences

title: Animaux en hiver
oneGoal: Students understand how animals prepare for and survive winter
decisionPoints: Are students interested in animal behavior?
Do students need animal pictures for support?
Should I include hibernation concepts?
progression: Builds on Lesson 3 by exploring how animals experience hiver differently
realWorldConnection: Animals have special ways to survive cold winter weather

title: Célébrations autour du monde
oneGoal: Students discover that many cultures celebrate during winter season
decisionPoints: Which cultural celebrations should I include?
Do students need visual supports for different traditions?
Should I focus on similarities or differences?
progression: Builds on Lesson 4 by introducing human winter célébrations and traditions
realWorldConnection: Many cultures have special celebrations during winter months

title: Noël autour du monde
oneGoal: Students explore how Christmas is celebrated in different French-speaking countries
decisionPoints: Should I include diverse Christmas traditions?
Do students celebrate Christmas at home?
How can I be inclusive of all students?
progression: Builds on Lesson 5 by exploring one specific winter célébration in detail
realWorldConnection: Christmas is celebrated differently around the world, including in French-speaking countries

title: Hanoukka - Festival des lumières
oneGoal: Students learn about Hanukkah as a winter celebration of lights
decisionPoints: Do students know about Jewish traditions?
Should I include hands-on menorah activity?
How can I teach respectfully about religious traditions?
progression: Builds on Lesson 6 by exploring another winter lumières celebration
realWorldConnection: Hanukkah is an important winter festival celebrating religious freedom and miracles

title: Kwanzaa - Célébration africaine-américaine
oneGoal: Students discover Kwanzaa as a cultural winter celebration
decisionPoints: How can I present Kwanzaa respectfully?
Do students need background on African-American culture?
Should I include the seven principles?
progression: Builds on Lesson 7 by adding another cultural winter célébration
realWorldConnection: Kwanzaa celebrates African-American culture and community values

title: Diwali d'hiver et autres fêtes
oneGoal: Students explore other cultural celebrations that can happen in winter
decisionPoints: Which other celebrations should I include?
Do students represent other cultures in class?
Should I focus on light themes across cultures?
progression: Builds on Lesson 8 by exploring global winter celebration diversity
realWorldConnection: Many cultures have light-based celebrations during dark winter months

title: Nouvel An autour du monde
oneGoal: Students discover different New Year celebrations and traditions
decisionPoints: Should I include lunar new year traditions?
Do students understand calendar concepts?
How can I make new year concepts age-appropriate?
progression: Builds on Lesson 9 by exploring winter new year célébrations
realWorldConnection: Different cultures celebrate new year at different times with unique traditions

title: Cuisine d'hiver réconfortante
oneGoal: Students explore comfort foods and special dishes from winter celebrations
decisionPoints: Should I include cooking or tasting activities?
Do students have food allergies to consider?
Which cultural foods should I represent?
progression: Builds on Lesson 10 by exploring what families eat during winter célébrations
realWorldConnection: Special foods and warm drinks are important parts of winter celebrations

title: Musique et chansons d'hiver
oneGoal: Students learn songs and music from different winter celebrations
decisionPoints: Which songs are appropriate for this age?
Should I include instruments or movement?
Do students need visual supports for song lyrics?
progression: Builds on Lesson 11 by adding musical elements to winter célébrations
realWorldConnection: Music and songs are essential parts of cultural celebrations

title: Créons nos décorations
oneGoal: Students create winter celebration decorations from different cultures
decisionPoints: Which decorations are manageable for Grade 1?
Do students need step-by-step craft support?
Should I focus on one culture or multiple?
progression: Builds on Lesson 12 by creating visual elements for winter célébrations
realWorldConnection: People decorate their homes and communities for winter celebrations

title: Notre festival d'hiver multiculturel
oneGoal: Students participate in a classroom winter celebration festival
decisionPoints: How should I organize the multicultural festival?
Should students present what they've learned?
Do families want to participate or observe?
progression: Builds on Lesson 13 by culminating all learning in a celebration festival
realWorldConnection: Communities often hold winter festivals celebrating cultural diversity

title: Histoires d'hiver magiques
oneGoal: Students explore winter stories and legends from different cultures
decisionPoints: Which winter stories are culturally inclusive?
Do students need visual story supports?
Should stories be read or told?
progression: Extension - applies winter vocabulary through storytelling and imagination
realWorldConnection: Cultures share winter stories that teach values and traditions

title: Jeux d'hiver intérieurs
oneGoal: Students play traditional winter games from different cultures
decisionPoints: Which games are appropriate for classroom space?
Do students need game instruction supports?
Should games be competitive or cooperative?
progression: Extension - reinforces winter vocabulary through traditional cultural games
realWorldConnection: Winter games help people stay active and connected during cold months

title: Cartes de vœux multiculturelles
oneGoal: Students create greeting cards for different winter celebrations
decisionPoints: Which celebration greetings should students learn?
Do students need writing support for cards?
Should cards be for classmates or families?
progression: Extension - uses winter celebration vocabulary in authentic communication
realWorldConnection: People send cards and greetings to share celebration wishes

title: Spectacle de talents d'hiver
oneGoal: Students perform songs, dances, or stories from winter celebrations
decisionPoints: What types of performances are comfortable for students?
Should performances represent different cultures?
Do students need costumes or props?
progression: Extension - demonstrates winter celebration learning through performance
realWorldConnection: Performance and entertainment are important parts of cultural celebrations

title: Interview avec les familles
oneGoal: Students interview family members about their winter celebration traditions
decisionPoints: Should interviews be homework or classroom role-play?
Do students need interview question supports?
How can I accommodate diverse family backgrounds?
progression: Extension - connects classroom learning to family traditions and experiences
realWorldConnection: Families are the primary source of cultural celebration knowledge

title: Calendrier de célébrations d'hiver
oneGoal: Students create a winter celebration calendar showing diverse cultural celebrations
decisionPoints: Should calendar include all celebrations studied?
Do students need calendar template support?
Should calendar be individual or class project?
progression: Extension - synthesizes all winter celebration learning in organized calendar format
realWorldConnection: Calendars help communities plan and remember important cultural celebrations
